name: Almond Crusted Tofu with Corn Yogurt Sauce, Green Beans & Tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the short side to make 2 smaller "blocks." Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
2 ¼ lb green beans
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and place the leaves in a blender.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the blender along with yogurt, mayo, water, and spices. Blend on high until yogurt sauce is smooth; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups frozen corn
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
mayonnaise
salt
black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Mince almonds. Place in a small bowl along with bread crumbs, and spices, then stir to combine the coating.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup almonds
½ cup panko bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer tofu to a plate, then season both sides with salt and pepper. Spread the tofu with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve baking sheet for the next step.)
Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels, then coat with a thin layer of oil. Return tofu to the baking sheet.
Trim and halve green beans crosswise. Transfer to a large baking sheet.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the baking sheet with the green beans. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast until tofu is golden and veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide yogurt sauce, green beans, and tomatoes between plates. Top sauce with tofu and enjoy!
